headline: A new law renames the East Derry, New Hampshire, post office after Chief Edward B. Garone.
what_it_does: This law officially names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 50 East Derry Road in East Derry, New Hampshire, the Chief Edward B. Garone Post Office. It changes only the name of the building. It does not change postal services, mail delivery, or any rules for customers.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on November 25, 2024, and the naming took effect on that date.
